name: reachinbox-scheduler
description: Persistent email scheduling, built for the ReachInbox engineering assignment.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @reachinbox/api" "npm run worker:dev -w @reachinbox/api" "npm run dev -w @reachinbox/web"
scripts.format: prettier --write apps scripts tests docs README.md package.json playwright.config.ts vitest.config.ts compose.yaml .github
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps scripts tests docs README.md package.json playwright.config.ts vitest.config.ts compose.yaml .github
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,worker "npm run start -w @reachinbox/api" "npm run worker -w @reachinbox/api"
